children: 3M sold €1.5 billion of euro-denominated notes in three tranches, pricing 3.500% (2028), 3.900% (2031) and 4.100% (2034).
Offered €500M each of 3.500% notes due 2028, 3.900% due 2031 and 4.100% due 2034; closing occurred Sept. 10, 2026.
Notes were sold under the company's Form S-3 registration and related prospectus supplements dated Sept. 3, 2026.
Proceeds expected to be used for general corporate purposes, including possible repayment, redemption or refinancing of debt.
Notes issued under existing indentures with BNY Mellon as successor trustee; underwriting agreement and global note forms filed as exhibits.
